subject: Engineering exercise: assignment launch, deadline, and reviewer plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres+applicant@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Engineering exercise: assignment and 72-hour deadline

Hi Lina,

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood Inference last week — we enjoyed speaking with you. As discussed, attached is the small engineering exercise we use to evaluate backend/infra candidates. The goal is to see design clarity, trade-off thinking, and a working prototype where reasonable.

Quick logistics: 
- Attached: assignment_spec.pdf (short spec, ~2 pages).
- Deadline: 72 hours from receipt (Fri, 8 Aug 2025 14:12 EDT). If you need an extension, please request before the deadline and explain constraints.
- Submission format: a zip with code + README; include a short writeup of design choices. We prefer GitHub links but accept zip attachments.
- Sandbox/data: non-sensitive sample data and a small GCS dataset are available in the Drive folder below. If you need temporary sandbox access for more infra-level testing, reply and we'll open a short-lived account.

Attachments and links:
- [Attachment: assignment_spec.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAssignmentSandbox

Next steps: acknowledge here so we know you received the spec. We'll assign reviewers and confirm when we get your submission.

Thanks — looking forward to your work.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference

-----
Stephanie Nguyen
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres+applicant@gmail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 15:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Engineering exercise: assignment and 72-hour deadline

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks — I received the spec and the Drive link. Quick question: the spec mentions a small GCS dataset and an API endpoint for validation. I don't currently have GCP creds; can you confirm whether the sample data is downloadable directly from Drive, or do I need sandbox credentials to run the validation? If sandbox creds are required I'd appreciate a short-lived account.

I plan to start tonight and will confirm when I push a draft.

Best,
Lina

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres+applicant@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 16:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Engineering exercise: assignment and 72-hour deadline

Hi Lina —

Thanks for the heads up. The bulk of the sample data is downloadable directly from the Drive folder (see the nested folder named sample-data). The API endpoint is optional for full validation; it's behind a short-lived service account we can enable if you want to exercise the live check.

We can enable sandbox credentials that expire in 48 hours if helpful — let me know and we'll provision them this afternoon. No need to wait for creds to start; the Drive download will work for the core tasks.

Best,
Stephanie

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 09:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Reviewer assignment & rubric for Lina Torres' submission

Team —

Lina is on the 72-hour window (sent yesterday). Attached is the rubric (reviewer_rubric.xlsx). Proposed plan:
- Primary reviewer: Aditya (deep infra/latency tradeoffs)
- Secondary reviewer: Logan (systems + correctness)
- Triage/ops notes: Stephanie will confirm when the submission lands and share the artifact.

Please confirm availability for a 45-minute sync to review together if either of you feels a live discussion is needed. Proposed slots: Wed 6 Aug 10:00-11:00 EDT, Wed 6 Aug 15:00-16:00 EDT. If you both prefer an async review, reply with your ETA (e.g., "I can review by 6 Aug 18:00").

Attachments: [Attachment: reviewer_rubric.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

Thanks,
Marissa
Recruiting Operations

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres+applicant@gmail.com>

Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2025 08:52:00 -04:00
Subject: Submission: Lina Torres - assignment

Hi Stephanie / Marissa —

Attached is my submission. I included a README with run instructions and a short design notes.md that outlines the key trade-offs I considered. I wasn't able to fully exercise the live API check (requesting sandbox creds this morning would have helped), so I included a test harness and scripts that point at the bundled sample data.

Attachments: [Attachment: submission_lina_torres.zip (ZIP, 1.2MB)]

Please confirm receipt when you have a moment. Happy to hop on a short call if reviewers want a walkthrough.

Best,
Lina
